step.label: Receive and log service request
step.description: Capture incoming service or change request from customers or internal stakeholders into the system.
step.useCase: IT support team logs a new service ticket for campaign access provisioning.

step.label: Assess campaign performance impact
step.description: Analyze historical campaign data and customer segmentation to determine if the request affects active marketing initiatives.
step.useCase: Marketing analytics dashboard shows that 3 active campaigns will be affected by the proposed system change.

step.label: Evaluate organizational approval requirements
step.description: Determine the required approval chain based on employee hierarchy and workforce organizational structure.
step.useCase: System identifies that IT Director and CFO must approve due to budget and access level implications.

step.label: Identify equipment and vendor dependencies
step.description: Cross-reference materials, vendors, and procurement requirements needed to implement the change.
step.useCase: Procurement team discovers that network equipment from 2 vendors must be ordered and 3 materials are in backorder.

step.label: Log formal change request and engineering review
step.description: Register the change formally in PLM system and route to engineering teams for technical feasibility assessment.
step.useCase: Change advisory board documents the RFC with technical specifications and identified IT equipment affected.

step.label: Execute quality assurance and defect prevention checks
step.description: Run automated quality gates and production order validation to ensure change will not degrade manufacturing or service operations.
step.useCase: QA agent simulates the change in test environment and verifies that production order processing remains compliant.

step.label: Coordinate incident response and stakeholder notification
step.description: Activate incident response protocols and notify all affected stakeholders of the planned change window and rollback procedures.
step.useCase: Incident coordinator sends alert to 15 affected teams and ensures IT Equipment asset inventory is updated pre-change.

step.label: Process time-off approvals for change window coverage
step.description: Ensure adequate staffing by processing employee time-off requests and confirming personnel availability during change implementation.
step.useCase: HR verifies that no critical on-call engineers have approved time-off during the 2-hour change window.
